'''Free Fire World Series''' ('''FFWS''' in short) is a [[Global_Events|Global]] tournament organized by Garena.

'''FFWS 2019''' is the first edition in the series and marks as the final event and the World Championship of 2019's Free Fire competitive season. Qualified are the 12 best teams throughout all regional leagues in the second half of 2019.
